axioms.name: Experimental.P03_05.lanczosBasisOfCyclic
axioms.meaning: An explicitly unit, cyclic vector for the actual whitened manuscript matrix admits an orthogonal tridiagonalizing basis with positive adjacent entries.
axioms.supports: Only cyclic tridiagonalization. No determinant ratio, fraction identity, chosen-vector cyclicity or exponential edge bound is assumed.
